mapper.insert: insert into RAW_HIE_DEATH_DOC ( DOCUMENT_ID, SOURCE_FACILITY, MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER, MPIID, FNAME, LNAME, DOB_TEXT, DOD_TEXT, DEATHTIME, CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS,RECEIVED_DATE,HIE_NAME) values ( #{documentId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sourceFacility, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{MRN, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{HXMPIID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{firstName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lastName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(FN_TO_DATE(trim(#{birthDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'MM/DD/YYYY'),'MM/DD/YYYY'), TO_CHAR(FN_TO_DATE(trim(#{deathDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'MM/DD/YYYY'),'MM/DD/YYYY'), #{deathTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currentProcessStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{receivedDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{hieName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO STD_HIE_DEATH_DOC ( DOCUMENT_ID,SOURCE_FACILITY,MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER,MPIID,FNAME,LNAME,DOB_TEXT,DOD_TEXT,DEATHTIME,CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS,RECEIVED_DATE,HIE_NAME,MATCH_CD,MATCH_PASS,MATCH_WEIGHT,MATCH_STATENO,QS_PARENT_DOC_ID,MATCHED_PROCESS_DATE) VALUES( #{DOCUMENT_ID,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, upper(trim(#{SOURCE_FACILITY,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), upper(trim(#{MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), #{MPIID,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, upper(trim(#{FNAME,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), upper(trim(#{LNAME,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), TO_CHAR(FN_TO_DATE(trim(#{DOB_TEXT,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'MM/DD/YYYY'),'MM/DD/YYYY'), TO_CHAR(FN_TO_DATE(trim(#{DOD_TEXT,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'MM/DD/YYYY'),'MM/DD/YYYY'), #{DEATHTIME,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{RECEIVED_DATE,jdbcType=DATE}, #{HIE_NAME,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, upper(trim(#{MATCH_CD,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), upper(trim(#{MATCH_PASS,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), #{MATCH_WEIGHT,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, upper(trim(#{MATCH_STATENO,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), #{QS_PARENT_DOC_ID,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{MATCHED_PROCESS_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} )
mapper.select: SELECT SHDC.DOCUMENT_ID AS documentId, SHDC.SOURCE_FACILITY AS sourceFacility, SHDC.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER AS MRN, SHDC.MPIID AS mpiid, SHDC.FNAME AS firstName, SHDC.LNAME AS lastName, SHDC.DOB_TEXT AS birthDate, SHDC.DOD_TEXT AS deathDate, SHDC.DEATHTIME as deathTime, SHDC.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS AS currentProcessStatus, SHDC.RECEIVED_DATE as receivedDate, SHDC.HIE_NAME as hieName, PDA.STATENO AS stateno, PDA.DISCARD_STATUS, SHDC.MATCH_CD, SHDC.MATCH_PASS, SHDC.MATCH_WEIGHT, SHDC.MATCH_STATENO, SHDC.QS_PARENT_DOC_ID, SHDC.MATCHED_PROCESS_DATE, SHDC.EHARS_IMPORT_DATE as eharsImportDate, SHDC.EHARS_STATUS_CD as eharsStatusCd, SHDC.NYC_SHIP_DATE as nycShipDate FROM STD_HIE_DEATH_DOC SHDC LEFT OUTER JOIN PERSON_DOC_ASSOCIATION PDA ON PDA.DOCUMENT_ID = SHDC.DOCUMENT_ID AND PDA.dissassociation_date IS NULL WHERE SHDC.DOCUMENT_ID =#{docId}

Select * from ( Select H.* ,p.STATENO , 'M' MATCH_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H.DOCUMENT_ID ORDER BY C.DOCUMENT_ID DESC) AS RWNUM from raw_hie_death_doc H, std_ccd_doc C, PERSON_DOC_ASSOCIATION p where (H.MPIID = C.MPI OR (H.fname = C.fname AND H.lname = C.lname AND H.DOB_Text = C.DOB_text AND H.MPIID != C.MPI)) and H.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 1 and p.DOCUMENT_ID = C.DOCUMENT_ID and p.DISSASSOCIATION_DATE IS NULL ) where RWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE raw_hie_death_doc SET current_process_status = 2 WHERE mpiid IN ( SELECT mpiid FROM ( SELECT fname, lname, mpiid, dod_text, medical_record_number, source_facility, dob_text FROM raw_hie_death_doc r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM std_hie_death_doc s WHERE s.mpiid = r.mpiid) GROUP BY fname, lname, mpiid, dod_text, medical_record_number, source_facility, dob_text HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) ) AND current_process_status = 1

UPDATE RAW_HIE_DEATH_DOC SET CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 2 WHERE ROWID IN ( SELECT row_id FROM ( SELECT ROWID AS row_id, fname, lname, document_id, mpiid ,dob_text, medical_record_number, dod_text, source_facility, RECEIVED_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() over (Partition by Fname ,Lname ,mpiid, dob_text, medical_record_number, dod_text, source_facility ORDER BY received_date, document_id) as rn from RAW_HIE_DEATH_DOC r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STD_HIE_DEATH_DOC s WHERE s.mpiid = r.mpiid) ) WHERE rn > 1 ) and current_process_status In (1,36,37)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mpi_change(CURRENT_MPI, OLD_MPI, DATE_RECEIVED) SELECT DISTINCT r.MPIID as CURRENT_MPI , s.MPI as OLD_MPI, sysdate FROM raw_hie_death_doc r , std_ccd_doc s where r.FNAME = s.FNAME AND r.LNAME = s.LNAME AND r.DOB_TEXT = s.DOB_TEXT AND s.MPI != r.MPIID AND (mpi_pair_exists(r.MPIID, s.MPI)) != 1 AND not exists (select 1 from mpi_change m where m.current_mpi = r.mpiid and m.old_mpi = s.mpi)
mapper.update: UPDATE RAW_HIE_DEATH_DOC r SET r.current_process_status = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STD_CCD_DOC c WHERE c.MPI = r.MPIID AND c.flux_MATCH_CD IN ('N','C_N','P_N')) OR EXISTS (select 1 FROM STD_CCD_DOC c WHERE r.FNAME = c.FNAME AND r.LNAME = c.LNAME AND r.DOB_TEXT = c.DOB_TEXT AND r.MPIID != c.MPI AND c.flux_MATCH_CD IN ('N','C_N','P_N')) THEN 36 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STD_CCD_DOC c WHERE (c.FNAME = r.FNAME AND c.LNAME = r.LNAME AND c.DOB_TEXT = r.DOB_TEXT) OR (c.MPI = r.MPIID)) THEN 37 ELSE 1 END WHERE r.current_process_status in (1,36,37)
